prompt: who won the formula one season in the year nine people were killed on the track at the argentine grand prix, and how old were they two years before sliced bread was first sold?
answer: The 1953 Formula One season was won by **Alberto Ascari**. Since sliced bread was first sold commercially in **1928**, two years earlier was **1926**; Ascari, born on July 13, 1918, was **7 at the start of that year and turned 8**.
